AI Ad Video Maker - Portable
============================

Quick start
-----------
1. Double-click AdVideoMaker.exe
2. (Optional) Settings tab -> "Get free key" -> paste your free
   Pollinations key -> Save key -> Test key
   (Without a key the app still works in animated-image fallback mode)
3. Create Ad tab -> enter your product -> Generate Ad

Recent tab
----------
- Every generation is saved as a project (script, visuals, voice, video)
- Interrupted or failed projects can be resumed from where they stopped
- "Create similar" loads a project's settings back into the form
- Delete removes a project and its files

Reference image
---------------
- Browse picks a product photo; Rotate / Crop edit it before generating
- Crop supports free, 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 ratios

Take it to any PC
-----------------
Copy the whole folder (or just AdVideoMaker.exe) to a USB drive.
On the target PC: Windows 10/11, no install needed - double-click the exe.

If you also copy an "output" folder next to the exe, videos are saved
there (USB-portable mode). Otherwise they go to Videos\AIAds.

Notes
-----
- Needs internet (AI services + voiceover); everything else is built in
- Your API key is stored in settings.json next to the exe
- First launch takes a few seconds while the app unpacks itself
